## Quarterly Risk Themes (Q2 2026)

1. **Regulatory volatility in Park City** is the single biggest existential risk to the growth thesis. We're underwriting a moratorium passage at 55% likelihood. If it passes, our 18-month plan needs to pivot to (a) deepening with existing owners (multi-property expansion at the same owner) and (b) opening Heber/Midway as the next market.
2. **Operational scale-up for summer peak** — cleaner roster, vendor capacity (especially HVAC for cabin units, pool service for Jordanelle properties), and supply chain (linen rotation) all need to be at 1.4x current capacity by July 1.
3. **Owner-portfolio concentration** — 5 owners (Westridge, Northstar, Sandra Park, Erik Lindqvist, Sloan Gerrard) represent 14 of our 24 units. Losing any one of them would be a 2-5 unit hit to the management book. Hannah is running a 1:1 cadence with each through Q2 to lock in 2027 commitments.
